title: Mass densities are unique
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P any set, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), x ∈ ℝ^P (= Euclid P) and θ, θ' ∈ ℝ. Suppose HasMassDensity T x θ and HasMassDensity T x θ', i.e. θ ≥ 0, θ' ≥ 0, and the ratio T.massOn(B_ρ(x)) / (ω_n·ofReal(ρ^n)) ∈ [0, ∞] (ω_n = unitBallVolume n, B_ρ(x) the open ball) tends both to ofReal θ and to ofReal θ' as ρ → 0⁺ (filter 𝓝[>] 0 on ℝ). Then θ = θ'.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (θ θ' : ℝ), HasMassDensity T x θ → HasMassDensity T x θ' → θ = θ'
